name: Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the water industry, providing advanced solutions for comprehensive water management. The company's extensive hardware portfolio includes intelligent products for leak detection and early warning, alongside smart valves for precise pressure regulation. It also manufactures a variety of advanced metering devices, such as remote multi-stream water meters (available in dry and wet types) and high-precision rotary-wing models. Furthermore, Heda offers specialized monitoring terminals to track vital metrics, including drainage levels, road water levels, smart manhole cover status, and pipeline velocity. Beyond hardware, Heda delivers a robust array of software platforms. These encompass unified smart water platforms, IoT connectivity solutions, emergency command systems, and sophisticated big data business intelligence tools for water resource analysis. The software capabilities extend to proactive leakage control and warning systems, pipeline pressure management systems, and comprehensive Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for network mapping, inspection, and maintenance. Additional software modules address field work order management and grid operational oversight. Moreover, Heda's software suite encompasses solutions for optimizing core operations, including production scheduling, scientific dispatch, online hydraulic modeling, and intelligent analysis with early warning for anomalous events. Specific management systems cater to secondary water supply, agricultural drinking water, application oversight, operating fee processing, comprehensive customer service, and metrology center functions. The company also furnishes systems for efficient equipment and water quality management. Established in 2000, Zhejiang Heda Technology Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Jiaxing, China.
